# Voice test fixtures — provenance

All clips are **synthetic**: generated by `make_fixtures.sh` with macOS text-to-speech voices on
2026-09-30. No human speaker, no patient, no real clinical encounter. They exist to exercise the
pipeline (VAD, engines, extractor, read-back) and are **not** a benchmark of accuracy on real speech.

| File | Voice | Script text |
|---|---|---|
| en_fever_102.wav | Rishi (en_IN) | "I have had fever for three days. My temperature is 102 degrees Fahrenheit. I do not have chest pain." |
| en_pulse_oxygen.wav | Rishi (en_IN) | "Pulse is one hundred and twenty. Oxygen is ninety two percent." |
| hi_fever_102.wav | Lekha (hi_IN) | "मुझे तीन दिन से बुखार है। तापमान 102 डिग्री है।" |
| hi_fever_saadhe.wav | Lekha (hi_IN) | "तापमान साढ़े उनतालीस डिग्री है और नब्ज़ एक सौ बीस है।" (39.5 — safety case: fraction word must block confirmation) |

Silence and noise clips are generated in the tests with numpy.

**Odia (pending).** `or_fever_102.wav` is generated by `make_odia_fixture.py` with Sarvam Bulbul v3 (`od-IN`), script
"ମୋର ତିନି ଦିନ ହେଲା ଜ୍ୱର, ତାପମାତ୍ରା ଏକ ଶହ ଦୁଇ ଡିଗ୍ରୀ". Synthetic, not a real patient. Cloud transcription of it is
`circular_if_cloud` (Sarvam both ways). **Not yet generated**: api.sarvam.ai was unreachable on 2026-10-01 (TLS handshake timeout).
